meta.title: Hunter data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60 vs a level 63 training dummy): Beast Mastery, Marksmanship, Survival and the pet
meta.scope: Auto Shot and the ranged rules, every ability a level-60 hunter uses against a raid boss, procs, the pet and Summon Hawk, mana economy, the three talent trees in gunba's order, every hunter build in gs and fs, priority lists, default stats, worked examples, and the melee-weaving decision with a practice-yard design sketch.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline), a URL, or a list of them. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend. Spell rows cited as fs sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go are the beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70124) stored in foreversim.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by Forever client data (spell rows, talent curves), a Wowhead Forever tooltip, Blizzard (development notes, class deep dive, community-manager posts), or measured on the beta. Most beta measurements were taken at levels 10-30.
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or both sims with no Forever source yet, or where sources disagree (including developer-style bug-tracker replies not flagged as Blizzard). Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

simsCompared.gs: gunba/wow-forever-sim (branch 'forever'), commit 9c05fc890b (2026-10-09). Engine: wowsims/classic with Forever rules. Hunter tree 16/16/18. Restores the Classic Auto Shot wind-up and cast gating (docs/auto_attack_audit.md). Survival and Pet/Melee are melee builds standing at 5 yd; MM and BM stand at 12 yd.
simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 255df1627f (2026-10-01). Engine: wowsims/forever with the beta client rows (1.60.1.70124). Same tree order as gs. Models the current beta behaviour: no Auto Shot wind-up, autos never held by casts, a 500 ms retry when moving, and a melee swing resetting the ranged timer. All three hunter APLs are ranged; test results use weapon-only gear.

practiceYardSummary: Auto Shot: cycle = ranged weapon speed / ranged haste. A 0.5 s / haste wind-up during which the hunter must stand still is intended (Blizzard CM, 23 Sep), but the beta currently runs ~0.1-0.2 s (bug #289). A failed start retries every 0.5 s.

Forever intent (developer-style reply on bug #76): Auto Shot keeps firing during Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot and Sniper Shot casts. fs models this; gs keeps Classic gating. Offer both; default to the Forever intent.
Beta: a melee swing resets the Auto Shot timer (bug #14, open, called a bug in a reply). Ranged does not reset melee. This decides melee weaving.

Aimed Shot (baseline): 2 s cast, normalized weapon + 166, 310 mana, 6 s cooldown shared with Multi-Shot (one rank, 0.5 s cast, 13.9% base mana). Arcane Shot 217 Arcane, 6 s, shared with Summon Hawk. Serpent Sting 555 over 15 s, crit-capable dynamic ticks. Sniper Shot (MM 31): 4 s cast, 15 s, +295, 365 mana.

Survival is a melee spec in gs (Aspect of the Beast +110 melee AP, Raptor Strike, Strider Kick, Mongoose Bite via Expose Prey on your own Hunter's Mark, Lacerating Strikes, dual wield). gs ranks BM ~904, Pet/Melee ~912, Survival ~900 and petless Marksmanship ~777 DPS (Orc).

Pet: 10 Focus/s continuous, cap 150; inherits 10% of max(AP, RAP) plus 100% of the hunter's crit and hit; damage per hit not normalized by speed; happiness x1.25; no external buffs. Cat: Bite (35 Focus, 10 s) and Claw (25 Focus).
Mana: ranged hunters spend ~4,800-4,900 mana/min in gs and survive only with raid Judgement of Wisdom, potions and runes. Offer a 'raid Judgement of Wisdom' toggle.
Melee weaving: optional advanced mode, off by default (see meleeWeaving).
meta.wowheadNote: Wowhead Forever talent tooltips print stale raw values (Unleashed Fury 20%, Ferocity 16%, Savage Strikes 20%, Barrage 15%, Lightning Reflexes 15%, Survival Tactics 17%, Bestial Discipline 100% Focus, Improved Arcane Shot 2 s). This sheet uses gs's tree (client trait curves). Ability tooltips (costs, cooldowns, ranges, damage) match the client rows.

weapons.value: Ranged: bow, crossbow, gun (thrown in the client too). Melee: one-hand or two-hand axe, sword, polearm, staff, fist, dagger; dual wield allowed.

armor.note: Same dummy as the other sheets (x0.5958 physical damage). gs's ranked builds face debuffed armor.

creatureType.value: Improved Tracking (+1%/point) works on Beast, Demon, Dragonkin, Elemental, Giant, Humanoid, Undead, not Mechanical. Dwarf +5% vs Beasts, Skyborne +5% vs Elementals.
creatureType.note: Give the practice dummy a creature-type option; gs's reference target is Dragonkin.

target.stunImmunity: Bosses are immune to stuns, roots, disorients and freezes: Intimidation's stun, Improved Concussive Shot, Scatter Shot, Entrapment, Improved Wing Clip, Freezing Trap. Intimidation still grants the pet's next-attack crit.

cycle.value: weapon speed / ranged haste, measured from wind-up start to wind-up start; damage lands at the end of the wind-up plus missile travel

intended.source: https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/630969 (Blizzard community manager Kaivax, 'Auto-shoot Bug and Fix Incoming', 2026-09-23)
intended.note: Blizzard: 'the 0.5-second cast time that precedes a Hunter's auto-shot ... is not functioning properly' and will be fixed. gs implements it (500 ms / RangedSwingSpeed).

betaNow.note: Reported 8 Oct after the patch; reply 9 Oct: 'known issue. Ranged code needs a rework'. fs models no wind-up at all.

retryTimer.note: When Auto Shot cannot start (moving, dead zone, out of range) it tries again every 0.5 s. Beta bug #43: casting any shot or sting, or /startattack, triggers a 0.1-0.4 s retry delay (not modelled; treat as a bug).

autosDuringCasts.value: Forever intent: Auto Shot keeps firing during Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot and Sniper Shot casts. gs: Classic gating (Auto Shot waits for a cast to finish; a cast cannot start during the wind-up).
autosDuringCasts.note: Bug #76 reply (22-23 Sep): 'Confirming that you are meant to be able to Auto Shot during those actions.' gs's audit shows that restoring Classic gating cut race-weighted MM from 917 to 807 DPS and BM from 879 to 845.

meleeResetsRanged.value: Beta: every melee swing (white or Raptor Strike) restarts the Auto Shot timer as if a shot had just fired. Ranged does not reset melee.
meleeResetsRanged.note: Reported 18 Sep, still present after the 8 Oct patch; reply 6 Oct: 'For Hunters, this is a Bug with Auto Shot.' Classic 1.12: independent timers. Wrath Classic linked both directions on purpose (Blizzard, 2022). fs models the reset; gs never mixes melee and ranged.

missileSpeed.note: Client SpellMisc 75. Aimed 40, Multi 30, Sniper 60, Summon Hawk 35.

damage.value: ranged weapon roll + ammo DPS x weapon speed + RAP/14 x weapon speed

autoShot.clipping: Clipping = the next Auto Shot starts late. Forever-intent model: only moving during the wind-up, standing in the dead zone or out of range at wind-up time delays it (plus up to 0.5 s of retry). Classic-gating model (gs): also any Aimed, Multi or Sniper cast that overlaps the moment the wind-up should start.

Melee Survival spends ~4,700/min but Judgement of Wisdom returns ~3,400/min. Without Judgement of Wisdom every spec is dry in 1-2 minutes on a typical sheet.

marksmanshipHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Marksmanship (ours)
marksmanshipHint.source: our synthesis of apl.marksmanshipGs and apl.marksmanshipFs
steps: Before the pull: Aspect of the Hawk, Trueshot Aura, your own Hunter's Mark (rank 4 = 71; rank 3 = 98 while the anomaly lasts).
Rapid Fire and racial on cooldown, ideally as Aimed Shot comes off cooldown.
Serpent Sting whenever it is not ticking (it also keeps Rapid Recuperation's casting regen up).
Aimed Shot on cooldown.
Sniper Shot when Aimed Shot has >= 3.5 s of cooldown left and mana >= 30%.
Arcane Shot at mana >= 15%; the instant to fire while moving.
Never Multi-Shot single-target (it would delay Aimed Shot).
Under ~40% mana use a potion or rune; under ~20% drop Sniper, then Arcane.

beastMasteryHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Beast Mastery (ours)
steps: Aspect of the Hawk, Hunter's Mark, send the pet.
Bestial Wrath + Rapid Fire + racial together.
Intimidation on cooldown.
Summon Hawk to keep two hawks (recast when fewer than 2, or the oldest has <= 1 s left).
Serpent Sting if missing.
Aimed Shot on cooldown.
Arcane Shot only when no hawk is needed (shared cooldown) and mana >= 15%.
Pet: Bite on cooldown, Claw with spare Focus.

survivalHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Survival melee (ours)
survivalHint.source: our synthesis of apl.survivalGs and apl.petMeleeGs
steps: Aspect of the Beast, your own Hunter's Mark (Expose Prey needs it), step into melee.
Raptor Strike on cooldown (off the GCD, next swing).
Strider Kick on cooldown.
Mongoose Bite whenever it lights up (10 s Expose Prey window).
Immolation Trap at your feet on cooldown (18 s with Survivalist's Discipline 2/2).
Refresh Hunter's Mark at <= 5 s.
Wing Clip as filler only above 40% mana with raid Judgement of Wisdom (60% without).
Pet/Melee build: add Summon Hawk on cooldown.

antiClipping.value: Classic-gating mode: start Aimed, Multi and Sniper right after an Auto Shot releases; never start a cast or move in the ~0.45 s before the next wind-up; instants are always safe. Forever-intent mode: only moving or standing in the dead zone when the wind-up is due delays the shot (plus up to 0.5 s of retry).

meleeWeaving.question: Should the practice yard implement melee weaving (a melee swing or Raptor Strike between Auto Shots)?

verdict.value: Optional advanced mode, off by default. Make melee Survival a core spec instead.
verdict.source: our recommendation from the evidence below

classicMechanics.value: Ranged and melee timers are independent. After an Auto Shot releases, step into melee, take a swing or Raptor Strike, step back and stand still before the next wind-up. Activate Raptor Strike only after entering melee range (a pre-queued strike is delayed by a hidden melee retry). Window = ranged speed - wind-up.

foreverChanges.value: Beta: a melee swing resets the Auto Shot timer (one direction only).
foreverChanges.note: Open since 18 Sep, still present after the 8 Oct patch; reply 6 Oct: 'For Hunters, this is a Bug with Auto Shot.' The wiki says it 'significantly affects melee weaving'. Wrath Classic linked both directions on purpose to end weaving (Blizzard producer, 2022).

foreverChanges.value: Auto Shot wind-up: 0.5 s intended, ~0.1-0.2 s live.
source: https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/630969 (Blizzard community manager Kaivax, 'Auto-shoot Bug and Fix Incoming', 2026-09-23)

foreverChanges.value: Autos fire during Aimed, Multi and Sniper casts (Forever intent), so casting at range costs no Auto Shots; a weave costs ~1 s in which no shot can be cast (nothing is castable while moving or inside 8 yd).
Raptor Strike +70 (Classic +140), 100 mana, 6 s, next swing; Efficiency -15% and Resourcefulness -60% now reduce its cost.
Rapid Fire hastes melee too but shrinks the ranged window; aspects cost mana and a 1.5 s GCD, and Beast (+110 AP) is worse than Hawk (+120 RAP, Quick Shots) for a weaver: no aspect swapping.
Melee is a full spec: gs ranks melee Survival ~900 and Pet/Melee ~912 DPS, level with BM (~904) and above petless MM (~777).

simsModel.value: Neither sim models weaving or reports a weaving gain. gs: ranged APLs stand at 12 yd, melee APLs at 5 yd; Auto Shot needs >= 12 yd and melee <= 5 yd; Raptor Strike appears only in the melee builds; no move actions. fs: legacy TBC rotation fields melee_weave / time_to_weave (shown only with a two-hand main hand) with no hunter code behind them; its core bakes in the beta melee->ranged reset and has wake-up hooks for out-of-range swings; no shipped APL moves.

guides.value: No Forever guide recommends weaving: classicwow.gg (8 Oct) gives no Forever schedule and notes the Auto Shot timing bug; the community wiki documents Classic weaving and flags the Forever reset; wowforeverbuilds (22 Sep) says the reset ends weaving.

engine: Ranged auto timer rangedNextAt with a 0.5 s / haste wind-up; needs: stationary, 8-35 yd, facing, not channeling Volley. A failed start retries every 0.5 s. Projectile 40 yd/s.
Dead zone: ranged needs distance >= 8 yd + target radius; melee needs <= 5 yd + combat reach; nothing fires between.
Both autos on at once and chosen by distance; the melee timer keeps running out of range, and a ready swing fires on entering range after a ~0.1-0.2 s retry.
Setting 'melee hit resets Auto Shot': beta (default; flagged as a bug), Classic (independent), Wrath (both reset).
Raptor Strike on the next swing: 6 s cooldown and cost on the hit, off the GCD; queued out of range = small retry delay on entering range.
Setting 'autos continue during casts': Forever (default on) or Classic gating (gs).

cues.stepIn: Right after an Auto Shot releases, if the melee swing will be ready on arrival, Raptor is ready (or white weaves are enabled), the remaining window >= travel in + travel out + 0.3 s margin, no Aimed or Sniper is due in that window, and neither Rapid Fire nor Quick Shots is active.
cues.stepOut: The moment the melee swing lands, or at the deadline nextWindupAt - travelOut - margin.
cues.abort: If the swing has not landed by the deadline, step out anyway.

foreverVsClassic: Aimed Shot is baseline at 20: 2 s cast (was 3), +166 (was +600), 6 s cooldown shared with Multi-Shot (was shared with Arcane Shot).
Multi-Shot: one rank, 0.5 s cast, no flat bonus (was +150), 13.9% base mana, 6 s cooldown (was 10).
Arcane Shot r8 217 (was 183) on its own cooldown, shared with Summon Hawk; Serpent Sting ranks 1-8 lower, rank 9 still 555; RAP scaling on both in beta logs; DoTs crit and do not snapshot.
Volley: no cooldown, 112 per tick (was 80). Raptor Strike +70 (was +140). Mongoose Bite = normalized weapon + 57 (was flat 115). Rapid Fire hastes melee too.
New: Sniper Shot, Summon Hawk, Strider Kick, Lacerating Strikes, Aspect of the Beast ranks 2-4 with melee AP, Counterattack rank 2.
Hunter's Mark r4 71 RAP (was 110) with Improved Hunter's Mark baseline; Aspect of the Hawk r6 55 and Trueshot r5 50 look like data anomalies; Trueshot Aura is ranged AP only.
Traps: usable in combat, placed at your feet, 30 s cooldown, separate fire and frost timers; AP scaling fix on 15 Oct.

Pets: inherit owner stats, 10 Focus/s continuous with a 150 cap, unique speeds without damage normalization, no external buffs; Foxes and one unique ability per family; Devilsaur Tooth only makes Revive Pet free.

Talents rebuilt (16/16/18 nodes, 16-point milestones): Lone Wolf, Careful Aim, Focused Fire, Expose Prey, Predator's Edge, Resourcefulness and more; Wyvern Sting, Killer Instinct, the Slaying talents, Improved Hunter's Mark and Thick Hide removed.
Disengage threat doubled and it disables auto-attack; Feign Death kills after 6 min; Human and Skyborne hunters; weapon racials give crit but not to ranged on the beta; Troll lost bow specialization.
Beta-only (flagged as bugs): Auto Shot wind-up ~0.1-0.2 s, melee resets the ranged timer, shots trigger the retry timer, ammo adds flat damage.

Hunter's Mark r3/r4, Aspect of the Hawk r6, Trueshot r4/r5 anomalies; ammo bug #113; weapon-racial crit on ranged (#91).

Will melee keep resetting the ranged timer (#14)? Will the fix be Classic (independent) or Wrath (both reset)? This decides whether weaving exists.
Arcane Shot and Serpent Sting scaling at level 60 (RAP share, SP removed?).
Does Mortal Shots cover Sniper Shot? Is Savage Strikes crit or damage?
Hawk swing damage, crit and Ferocity transfer at rank 4; can hawks coexist with Lone Wolf?
Pet AP slope at fast speeds; will fast pets be normalized (#31)? Will pets re-inherit stats dynamically (#48)?
Hunter's Mark rank 3 (98) vs rank 4 (71); Trueshot rank 4 (75) vs rank 5 (50).
Judgement of Wisdom proc rule for ranged hits (gs CORE-007).
Practical dead zone against large raid bosses (minimum range measured to the target's centre).
